data.name: Regina
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Regina means 'queen' or 'ruler'. In Christian tradition, this name is used for saints, queens, and royal figures. In the Bible, the name is given to Mary, mother of Jesus, in the Apocryphal Gospel of James. This title emphasizes her regal status as the mother of the King of Kings.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the queenly role of Mary as mother of God.

in_hebrew.name: רגינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רגינה נגזר מהמילה העברית 'מלכה' ומשמעותו 'מלכה' או 'שולטת'. הוא קשור למושג המלכות והשלטון, ומשמש לעתים קרובות ככינוי לאלהות או לישויות רוחניות גבוהות. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם רגינה מייצג את המלכות הרוחנית והשלטון של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ρeginα
in_greek.meaning: Βασίλισσα του ουρανού και της γης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Regina προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'regina', που σημαίνει 'βασίλισσα'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της βασιλείας και της πνευματικής εξουσίας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες έννοιες αναφέρονται στη σχέση της Εκκλησίας με τον Θεό και τον Ιησού Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Regina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Regina derivatur a Latina voce 'regina', quae 'regina' seu 'domina' significat. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen exprimit regnum spirituale et dominationem Dei. In Ecclesia primitiva, similes conceptus referebantur ad relationem inter Deum et fideles.

in_english.name: Regina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Regina is derived from the Latin word 'regina', meaning 'queen'. It symbolizes spiritual royalty and dominion, reflecting the Christian concept of God's kingdom. Historically, the name has been associated with the Virgin Mary, often referred to as 'Regina Caeli' (Queen of Heaven). The name Regina conveys a sense of majesty, leadership, and spiritual authority.

data.cultural_impact: The name Regina has a rich cultural history, with its Latin roots reflecting a sense of power, authority, and sovereignty. It has been popular in various European cultures and continues to be used as a given name in many parts of the world. In Christianity, the name has a special significance as it has been bestowed upon numerous saints and spiritual figures.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Regina holds deep spiritual significance, particularly in reference to Mary, the Mother of God. As the title "Queen of Heaven" or "Mother of God", Regina emphasizes Mary's queenly role and her status as a ruler in the spiritual realm. It also highlights her regal position as the mother of Jesus, the King of Kings, and the one through whom all blessings flow. This name is a powerful reminder of the importance of Mary's role in the Christian faith and the deep spiritual connection that believers have with her.
